esp32.detail: 3 pins wired; ACS758 50 A current sensor module needs at least 4.5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.OU1 → D32 (GPIO32) — an analog-capable pin. Added a 10 kΩ / 20 kΩ divider on OU1: it swings to 5 V, and the D32 pin takes 3.3 V at most. Added the acs758.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the current set on the slider: passes
